faq.q: What is the origin of Abdulghani?
faq.a: Abdulghani is associated with Arabic. Abdulghani is Arabic عَبْدُ الْغَنِي (ʿAbd al-Ghanī), meaning 'servant of the Self-Sufficient'.
Yes — the underlying form عَبْدُ الْغَنِي is Arabic.
Abdulghani can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Abdulghani should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿAbd al-Ghanī is a compound of two Quranic elements, not itself a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Abdulghani mean in Urdu?

faq.q: What does Abdulghani mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Abdulghani is rendered عبدالغنی and carries the sense عبدالغنی، بنده غنی.
A romanized syllable approximation is ab-dul-gha-ni. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.
